Sasha (sec-eng): Heads-up — customers reporting missing audit events for RBAC role changes and KMS key ops during a high-traffic window (02:14-02:20 UTC). Anyone else see gaps? cc @Priya
Priya (platform): We pushed a schema tweak last night that added required 'actor_source'. Could that cause validator rejects?
Marco (infra): Noticed a spike in audit-ingest queue at that time. audit.queue.latency peaked ~1200ms. Looks like validator CPU spiked and backpressure built up.
Sasha (sec-eng): Customers say events show up in raw kafka but not in their customer-facing feed (S3/index). Might be validator dropping them or indexing timeout + dedup.
Jules (customer-sre): Replayed one affected customer's stream — raw topic contains the event but the validator emitted: `ValidationError: actor_source is required` and the event was routed to dead-letter.
Priya (platform): Ok I can reproduce locally. Validator JSON schema is strict. Short-term I'll change actor_source to optional and log a warning instead of rejecting.
Marco (infra): FYI the strict validation also changed how batching behaves — we saw batch sizes swell (autoscaler reacted oddly), increasing mem/IO and causing ES indexing lag. That amplifies cost.
Sasha (sec-eng): Two asks: (1) hotfix validator to tolerate missing actor_source; (2) add a per-tenant metric for `validation_rejects` and a circuit-breaker so a bad tenant can't cause cluster-wide backpressure. thoughts on cost tradeoffs?
Priya (platform): Agree. Hotfix first. For cost, we can sample full validation under high QPS (e.g., 1% strict, 99% fast-path) to keep correctness signals without CPU burn.
Marco (infra): Sampling + dynamic batching cap sounds good. Proposal: cap batch_size to 64 when audit.queue.latency > 500ms, otherwise allow 128. That reduces peak mem spikes and ES pressure.
Jules (customer-sre): Customers will ask how to interpret sampled/partially-validated events. Can we add `validation.status` in the event payload: `trusted|partial|rejected`? That helps downstream compliance teams.
Sasha (sec-eng): Yes, include validation.status and a `validation.notes` when partial. Also we found KMS operations missing correlation_id — KMS wrapper async job didn't propagate request_id into audit event. Need to add correlation_id so key usage isn't orphaned.
Priya (platform): I'll add correlation_id propagation in the KMS client and add it to the audit schema. Migration plan: 1) deploy validator relax hotfix, 2) enable dynamic batching caps, 3) rollout correlation_id, 4) re-enable strict validation gradually with sampling and monitor `validation_rejects`.
Marco (infra): Deployment order SGTM. I'll also put an ingress throttling rule for any tenant exceeding configured QPS to protect shared index costs.
auditbot: Incident created: INC-2026-0912 audit-ingest-schema-regression. Pager: Marco (oncall). Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-0912
Sasha (sec-eng): Thanks all. Jules can you draft a short customer note explaining partial validation and the `validation.status` field? Priya/Marco let's jump in 20 to walk the rollout steps. :thumbsup:
